annotations.title: By what date must a foreign resident who leaves Japan be back so their status doesn't lapse?

description: Applies Japan's Immigration Control Act art. 26-2 (deemed re-entry permit, みなし再入国許可), art. 26 (regular re-entry permit) and art. 20(6) (special period while an extension or change of status is pending), with Civil Code date counting (departure day not counted; leave 2026-10-24 → back by 2027-10-24; expiry 2026-12-30 + 2 months → 2027-02-28). Rules as of 2026-10-24. Deemed re-entry: 1 year from departure, or the period-of-stay expiry if earlier; special permanent residents 2 years; CANNOT be extended abroad; not available to temporary visitors (短期滞在), periods of 3 months or less, or refugee-applicant Designated Activities. Renewal/change pending past expiry: return by the earlier of 1 year from departure or old expiry + 2 months, and receive the decision at the immigration office by then (ISA Q&A). Regular permit: its expiry (max 5 years, SPR 6), extendable at an embassy by up to 1 year. Returns verdict (in_time | too_late | deadline_only | no_deemed_reentry | already_expired), returnBy with legal basis, days allowed, margin vs returnDate, specialPeriod {endsOn, mustReceiveDecisionBy}, canExtendAbroad, steps (ED card tick box), warnings, sources, disclaimer. Use for 'how long can I leave Japan', 'can I travel while my visa renewal is pending', permanent residents abroad. Educational, not legal advice; not affiliated with ISA.

pending.description: Extension or change-of-status application filed before expiry and not yet decided. Default none.

periodExpiry.description: YYYY-MM-DD period-of-stay expiry on the residence card (在留期限). Required for mid_long; not for permanent/spr.

permit.description: deemed (みなし再入国, default) or a regular re-entry permit in the passport (single / multiple).

permitExpiry.description: YYYY-MM-DD expiry of a regular re-entry permit (required if permit is single or multiple).

returnDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD planned return, to check in_time vs too_late and the margin.

status.description: mid_long = residence card holder (work, student, spouse, dependent, long-term resident…); permanent; spr = special permanent resident; short_term = tourist / temporary visitor; three_months_or_less; refugee_applicant (Designated Activities).
